'''Russo Berlihat''' was an analytical [[Programmer/Legends|programmer]] who studied at the finest [[Technical Academy]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. After a stint working under a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] on [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]], Berlihat was contracted to work for Moff [[Bandor (Moff)|Bandor]] on [[Questal/Legends|Questal]]. Despite being paid well, Bandor ordered Berlihat to feed [[Lonchant]], a [[Protean]] who lived in his [[Game Chambers]]. While carrying out the Moff's orders, Berlihat was killed by the Protean after belatedly realizing he was the Proteans meal, not the tray of [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetables]] he was carrying.<ref name="SS" />
